release.content: pubkit 0.11.2 was released on 2026-10-20 from commit 9c91f331d80bc17b68f40c856c22d83ddc2367ce with these changes.

rows: node-ci.yml, a reusable workflow for a Node package: npm ci without install scripts, npm test, optional browser tests (npx --no-install), pubkit sync --check, and the sonar and passed jobs; pubkit init --kind=utility seeds it where a package.json has no pyproject.toml beside it

rust-ci.yml, python-ci.yml and node-ci.yml run a sonar job: given a SONAR_TOKEN secret (secrets: inherit) it sends the code to SonarQube Cloud as the project OWNER_REPO in the organization OWNER, and without one it passes with a notice; the seeded ci.yml files pass secrets: inherit
Every action pubkit's workflows use is pinned to a full commit hash, with its version in a comment, so a moved tag cannot change what runs
